notify.assigned: You are assigned to a video

ig.title: Auto-publishing
ig.settingsText: Videos and photos from the idea card are published to Instagram at the set time using the Facebook Page token.
ig.scopesHint: The page token needs instagram_basic, instagram_content_publish, pages_read_engagement. The Instagram account must be professional and linked to the Facebook Page.
ig.checkOk: Access OK: {username}, {usage} of {total} posts used in 24 h
ig.publishingHint: Meta is processing the file; the status updates within a few minutes
ig.failedKeep: The file is kept for {days} days for a retry, then deleted automatically.
ig.req1: Reels: MP4 or MOV (H.264 or HEVC video, AAC audio), vertical 9:16, 1080×1920 recommended, 23–60 fps.
ig.req2: Duration 3 seconds to 15 minutes; file size in the CRM up to {mb} MB (Meta has its own limits that may change; a Meta error is shown if they are not met).
ig.req3: Photo: JPEG (PNG is converted to JPEG), up to 8 MB, aspect ratio 4:5 to 1.91:1.
ig.req4: Caption up to 2,200 characters and 30 hashtags.
ig.req5: Upload the iPhone file as is (original): it is sent to Meta without recompression.
ig.caption: Caption
ig.captionHint: With hashtags; line breaks are kept
ig.thumbOffset: Cover frame, second of the video
ig.thumbOffsetHint: If no cover is uploaded; empty means the first frame
ig.scheduledHint: Cron publishes within a minute after this time
ig.cancelConfirm: Cancel auto-publishing and delete the uploaded file?
ig.qualityNote: Instagram always re-encodes video on its side; the CRM sends the original file, so quality is the best possible.

errors.permission: Missing instagram_content_publish (or another required) permission — add it to the system user and regenerate the page token. Meta response: {error}
errors.noAccount: No professional Instagram account is linked to the Facebook Page
errors.quota: Instagram publishing limit reached: {usage} of {total} in 24 hours. Retry later.
errors.missingScopes: Missing permissions: {scopes} — add them to the system user and regenerate the page token
errors.fileMissing: Publication file not found — upload it again
errors.coverType: Cover must be JPG or PNG
errors.mediaType: An MP4/MOV (video) or JPG/PNG (photo) file is required
errors.storage: Could not save the file on the server
errors.chunkOrder: File parts arrived out of order — restart the upload
errors.incomplete: The file is incomplete — restart the upload
errors.duration: Reels duration must be {min} s to {max} min
errors.imageRatio: Photo aspect ratio must be between 4:5 and 1.91:1
errors.pngUnsupported: PNG is not supported on this server — upload a JPG
errors.locked: Publishing is in progress or done — it cannot be changed
errors.noMedia: Upload a video or photo to publish
errors.captionLong: Caption must be at most {max} characters
errors.notApproved: Only an approved idea can be scheduled (stages “Approved” to “Scheduled”)
errors.timeRequired: Set the publish date and time
errors.timePast: The publish time has already passed
errors.retryOnlyFailed: Only a failed publication can be retried
errors.fileGone: The file was deleted — upload it again
errors.interrupted: Publishing was interrupted on the server — retry
errors.processingTimeout: Meta did not process the file within 24 hours

errors.mediaPublished: The file is already published in at least one place and cannot be replaced. You can upload a separate version for Telegram.
errors.unknownTarget: The selected destination was not found — reload the page
errors.noTargets: Choose where to publish: Instagram or a Telegram channel

tg.settingsText: Videos and photos from the idea card are posted to the selected channels at the scheduled time by the CRM bot.
tg.instruction: Add the bot {bot} as a channel administrator with the right to post messages
tg.step1: Open the channel in Telegram → Manage channel → Administrators → Add administrator.
tg.step2: Find {bot} and enable the “Post messages” right.
tg.step3: Enter the channel @username or its numeric id (-100…) below and press “Check and add”.
tg.removeConfirm: Remove the channel from the list? Draft and failed publications to it will be removed.
tg.chatHint: For example @fluggi_uz, https://t.me/fluggi_uz or -1001234567890 (for a private channel)
tg.added: Channel “{channel}” added: the bot can post
tg.publishingHint: The file is being sent to Telegram
tg.versionUploaded: Telegram version uploaded — Telegram gets it, Instagram gets the original file
tg.versionRemoved: Telegram version removed — Telegram will get the original file
tg.noChannelsHint: Telegram channels are added in Settings → Integrations.
tg.captionHint: In Telegram a media caption is limited to 1024 characters: a longer caption continues in the next channel message.

errors.botNotConfigured: The Telegram bot is not configured (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in .env)
errors.notFound: Channel not found: check the @username or id and add the bot {bot} to the channel as an administrator
errors.notChannel: This is not a channel — specify a Telegram channel
errors.notAdmin: The bot {bot} is not a channel administrator — add the bot {bot} as a channel administrator with the right to post messages
errors.cannotPost: The bot {bot} lacks the “Post messages” right — enable it in the channel administrator settings
errors.invalid: Enter the channel @username, a t.me/… link or a numeric id (-100…)
errors.duplicate: This channel has already been added
errors.inUse: The channel is selected in a scheduled or running publication — untick it in the idea card first
errors.channelRemoved: The channel was removed from settings — choose another one
errors.channelNotReady: Channel “{channel}”: the bot cannot post — press “Check” in Settings → Integrations
errors.videoTooLarge: The Telegram bot can send videos up to {mb} MB; upload a compressed version for the channel or untick Telegram
errors.photoTooLarge: The Telegram bot can send photos up to {mb} MB; make the photo smaller or untick Telegram
errors.versionType: The Telegram version must be an MP4 or MOV video

editorHint: Optional: an employee with the Editor specialty. A published video earns them the editor rate.

finance.title: SMM — finance
finance.subtitle: What our own SMM costs: pay for SMM specialists, videographers and editors, other expenses and the result
finance.peopleHint: Salary by video plan, per-video pay (videographer, editor), SMM sales bonus
finance.peopleEmpty: No SMM pay for this month
finance.peopleEmptyHint: Set the salary and video plan in Payroll and the per-video rates on the right
finance.payHint: Pay out in the monthly Payroll: calculate → approve → pay. "Paid" means payroll rows with the Paid status.
finance.otherHint: Props, studio, ads and more — included in the monthly SMM cost
finance.deleteConfirm: Delete the expense? The linked accounting operation will be deleted too.
finance.toAccountingHint: An expense operation on the chosen account (in UZS)
finance.noAccounts: No active UZS accounts — add one in Accounting
finance.ratesHint: For each published video, UZS; 0 — not paid
finance.ratesNote: The amount is fixed at publication: a new rate applies to the next videos. A personal rate is set in the employee card (Rates).
finance.payAssignee: Pay the per-video rate to the SMM manager if they shoot it themselves
finance.payAssigneeHint: Off: if the idea assignee is also the videographer or editor, no rate is paid (the work is part of their salary)
finance.personalRateHint: Empty — the role rate from SMM → Finance: videographer {videographer}, mobilographer {mobilographer}, editor {editor}

reverse.period_changed: Publication date moved to another month

errors.accountRequired: Choose an account to record in Accounting
errors.accountInvalid: An active UZS account is required
errors.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero
errors.accountingLinked: The expense is recorded in Accounting — only someone with Accounting rights can delete it
